Class SocketServerHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.client.SocketServerHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer, VirtualServerSocket, Runnable
public class SocketServerHandler extends Object implements Runnable, VirtualServerSocket
Handles client-side communication with the server over a TCP socket. Implements VirtualServerSocket to send commands (join, place totem, take card) as JSON lines, and runs a listener thread that reads incoming ServerNotification objects and applies them to the local ClientModel.

This class is the Socket-side counterpart of SocketClientHandler: commands sent via send(ClientCommand) are deserialised and executed there, while notifications sent from SocketClientHandler are received and applied here via ServerNotification.apply(ClientModel).

On connection loss, starts a reconnect watcher thread that polls the server until it comes back online, then instructs the player to rejoin.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Listener thread that continuously reads JSON lines from the server. Each line is deserialized into a ServerNotification and applied to the ClientModel. On connection loss, triggers crash recovery.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable

    • joinGame

      public void joinGame(int numPlayers, String nickname)
      Sends a request to join or create a game with the given number of players.

      Sends a JoinGameCommand carrying both numPlayers and nickname; unlike placeTotem(String, char) and takeCard(String, String), the nickname has not yet been established on the server side, so it must be included here.

      Specified by:
      joinGame in interface VirtualServer
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the desired game size
      nickname - the player's chosen display name

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(String nickname, char position)
      Sends a request to place the player's totem on the given offer-track slot.

      Sends a PlaceTotemCommand carrying only position; nickname is not transmitted because the server already identifies this connection by the nickname registered during joinGame.

      Specified by:
      placeTotem in interface VirtualServer
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player performing the action
      position - the offer-track slot (A–G) on which the totem should be placed

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect()
      Notifies the server that the client is disconnecting cleanly.

      Default no-op implementation: not all transports require an explicit disconnect notification (e.g. closing a socket stream is itself the signal), so implementations override this only when a transport-specific cleanup call is needed.

      Closes the underlying socket, if open. After this call, the listener thread's run() loop will exit via an IOException on the next read.

      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface VirtualServer
